proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the disc(s) (label side) and the inside of the case showing what’s included (confirm “double plate”).
Send a photo of the receipt and any included “pads”/inserts.
Confirm whether the item is ONLY the PS4 game (disc + case) or a console/device (since the text mentions ports/overheating).
response.reason: The photo clearly shows a PS4 game case (Red Dead Redemption II), but the seller’s claims are about a device (ports/overheating) and extras (receipt/pads) that are not shown. Without proof of what exactly is included and whether it’s complete/working, a safe price cannot be set from the provided comparables.
